purpose: Limited classification and exact-label-format compression calibration, not security-specific evidence or a novelty claim
source_key_policy: Use all original32 frozen source keys, with_demos versions unchanged, including all13 Full-wrong cases; no selection by context benefit or compression output
frontend: Original frozen native system header+examples then user query; user query and answer not available to the selector; no extra model calls for scoring
compression_scope: Query-blind eviction of completed system prefix only; user suffix appended at original logical positions; decode KV grows normally and is separately counted
baseline_policy: Reuse the audited same-version32 with_demos Full outputs. First3 new hook/no-hook/100%-retention checks must reproduce their output IDs before any compressed main outputs; no silent reuse if source or decode changes

budget.header_protection: All native token positions overlapping the exact shared system-header character span, including any boundary-crossing token; excludes demonstrations except boundary overlap. Compute per case before inference, record indices/count/byte cost, and charge within the same fixed total budget
budget.infeasible_policy: Stop the entire preparation before model inference; do not truncate the protected header, increase budgets, or drop cases

adapted_snapkv.gqa_reduction: mean over query heads sharing a KV head
adapted_snapkv.label: Existing independent Qwen2 adaptation, not original fair SnapKV or a new algorithm

random.policy: Deterministic per source-key/layer/KV-head random scores on original positions; same score stream for pinned/unpinned variants, with common anchors and required header charged before filling remaining slots; no gold or model outcome access

correctness_outputs: Additional bounded checks only, recorded separately; no full baseline resampling or parameter sweep
primary_scorer: Same raw whole-response exact gold and exact-label format scorer as baseline; only terminal EOS transport token removed, no other special token/text filtering
reporting: Full-to-compressed C2C/C2W/W2C/W2W with original32 and Full-correct19 denominators
per-layer/head retained original indices and actual K/V bytes
protected header footprints and any boundary overlap
NoDemo comparison kept separate from compression pairs
engineering_gate: CPU freeze all32 header spans, budgets and selector inputs before generation
CPU synthetic-cache selection identity at100%, anchors, header completeness, unique sorted in-range indices, exact equal bytes across all4 methods and reproducible random replay
Review/pin scoring source and adapter hashes; no copied nano-vllm files
On first3 frozen with_demos cases, score hook preserves every reference K/V tensor and Full output IDs versus no hook and archived baseline
Actual100%-retention gather identity and output equality, physical cache versus original logical RoPE positions checked
Before main generation assert every case/method/layer/KV-head budget and common/header inclusion; save full maps
Execution snapshot enabled only after engineering checks; failures retained with no silent fallback
interpretation: All outcomes are descriptive pilot results. Report no effect or improvements as well as damage; do not tune until deterioration appears. Classification changes are not safety failures, and label-format retention is not general policy/safety retention. Header pinning and random controls are diagnostic baselines, not proposed novel methods.
old_gates: Stopped native IFEval proposal and failed AccessDenied gates remain unchanged
selection_semantics: Stable score-descending selection excluding charged mandatory positions, tie by original index; original-position sorted physical gather
